title: Men's Eagle – Bald by Choice. Majestic by Nature. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
short: Bald by Choice. Majestic by Nature.
who: the man who wears his thinning hair like an eagle wears its white crest, zipped on for the ball game and the long drive.

chest: a small BALD BY over CHOICE. wordmark in the same engraved serif capitals as the back

gift_line: for the friend who is proudly bald and calls it majestic.
